title: Tangent classes for matroid building sets
summary: Significant combinatorial constraints and structure on matroids can come from notions in algebraic geometry, even without the matroids themselves being representable. Let \(M\) be a loopless matroid on a finite ground set \(E\), and let \(\G\) be a building set containing the top flat \(E\). We define a tangent class \(T_{M,\G}\) in the \(K\)-ring \(K(M,\G)\), which extends the tangent bundle class of the de Concini--Procesi wonderful model from realizable matroids to arbitrary matroids with building sets. The class \(T_{M,\G}\) satisfies a matroidal Hirzebruch--Riemann--Roch package. More…
